name: app-release
description: The /release command for an Amanorsac app repo: checks the GitHub build, fetches the installers, records the app, runs /brag, writes handoff.md, uploads the package to R2 under releases/<app>/<version>/ and tells the website chat. Follows docs/release-standard.md in the website repo.

app.title: Catalog id
app.description: The app's id in the website's catalog.json (chordlight88, nebulatide2, ...)

remote.title: rclone remote
remote.description: The rclone remote that holds amanorsac-downloads

website_session.title: Website chat
website_session.description: The name or id of the website's Claude Code chat, for the hand-off message (SendMessage). Empty: the model is told to find it with ListAgents.
